title: 凯隐·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 深发部分束起并夹有蓝色发束，异化手臂呈鲜明红黑色。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Kayn is an adult man with long dark hair partly tied back, a vivid blue hair streak, a sharp face, and a distinctive red-black transformed arm. Preserve the asymmetry while fully covering his torso in a dark sleeved tunic above opaque trousers and boots. His enormous curved scythe Rhaast rests grounded beside him with its blade lowered and red eye a quiet decorative detail.
art_direction.scene: A slightly elevated complete figure, asymmetric curved silhouette, naturally separated hands and a small sunlit ground cue. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: ink black, crimson, blue accent, pale stone; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
